name: mcp-tool-contract
title: MCP Tool Contract, Agent Readiness & x402 Auditor
description: Audits MCP endpoints, OpenAPI specifications, and Apify Actors for tool contracts, agent readiness, x402 payment requirements, Store metadata, and security risks.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Add one or more MCP endpoints, OpenAPI specifications, or Apify Actors.

errorMessage.minItems: You must provide at least one target to audit.

type.title: Target type
type.description: The kind of target to audit: a remote MCP endpoint, an OpenAPI specification, or an Apify Actor.

url.title: URL
url.description: Full HTTP or HTTPS URL for an MCP or OpenAPI target.

errorMessage.pattern: URL must start with http:// or https:// and include a valid domain.

actorId.title: Actor ID
actorId.description: An Actor ID or owner/name. Used for Apify Actor targets.

errorMessage.pattern: Invalid Actor ID format! Must include both the username and name separated by a slash (e.g., apify/website-content-crawler).

name.title: Display name
name.description: Optional label used in generated reports.

errorMessage.minLength: Display name cannot be empty if specified.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Choose the compliance categories to run.

errorMessage.minItems: Please select at least one audit scope category check to execute.

failOn.title: Fail run at severity
failOn.description: Return a non-zero exit code when findings reach this severity.

exportFormats.title: Report formats
exportFormats.description: Additional report formats to write to the Key-Value Store.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time to wait for each network request, in seconds.

maxRedirects.title: Maximum redirects
maxRedirects.description: Maximum number of HTTP redirects to follow before failing the request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers used by the Actor to hide its origin IP. Leave disabled for direct connections.

includePassingChecks.title: Include passing checks
includePassingChecks.description: Include successful checks in the dataset and SUMMARY report alongside warnings and errors.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Validate configurations, pathing formats, and fields without executing external network calls.
